proposal.name: Recover modeled drafts from saved run references

plan.name: Recover modeled drafts from saved run references
plan.summary: Add an optional versioned proposal_ref marker representation and shared decoding, result validation and resolution for factory and dashboard callers, binding the repository, issue, completed draft step, immutable result commit, SHA-256 of the exact complete result.json bytes and proposal identity while retaining legacy inline markers and completed records. Save the effective project directory, agent and caller-owned check context before finishing a draft run, and resolve authenticated references before every factory consumer uses a proposal, checking complete reader, preview, comparison and receipt evidence with reads confined to that run's pinned result.json; malformed, conflicting, unavailable or corrupt references must produce retryable diagnostics without falling back, consuming commands, repeating completed agents or building. Carry references through partial answers, ratification, stopped and failed posts without embedding the payload again, retaining original preview contexts, actual answers, revision baselines and amendment targets, and commit exactly the statements and bounds ratified by the person. Keep ordinary new-draft publication and its existing comment and 4 MiB expanded-marker refusals unchanged, impose no such limit on saved payloads, preserve lease and refused-effect rules and the proved cores, and exercise the complete change with real Git recovery and existing checking fixtures. Update SPEC.md, docs/statecharts.md and docs/factory.md to describe this optional representation and unchanged publication policy, cite D-0036, D-0069, D-0034, D-0345, D-0355, D-0362 and D-0387 as applicable, and identify the new storage refinement for the merger to record because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790SharedResolution
tests.says: A shared resolver reads only the completed run's immutable result.json and returns the complete checked payload, including more than 4 MiB, without changing proposal identity or marker limits.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790RatificationAndCarriedPosts
tests.says: A fresh watcher and clone resolve a reference before ratification and building, commit the exact pins and sources, and keep later ratified, successful and failed markers compact and decodable.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790ChoicesAndBaselines
tests.says: Partial choices survive restart without changing checked preview contexts; final answers carry a baseline without becoming revisions, while revisions retain complete previous proposals and original amendment targets.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790InvalidReferencesStayPending
tests.says: Malformed, copied, conflicting, incomplete and corrupt references block every active factory reader and pending commands without fallback; a later successful read retries the same command exactly once.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790EvidenceCannotBeSubstituted
tests.says: Even with a matching payload digest, invalid reader, source, preview, receipt or required comparison evidence cannot become a usable proposal.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790OnlyFactoryCommentsEstablishReferences
tests.says: Only comments accepted by the existing factory-author rule establish references or cause saved-record reads; a copied reference in a person's comment cannot replace the working proposal.

tests.name: TestSavedDraft790EffectivePayloadPrecedesCompletion
tests.says: The result commit already holds the publication's effective directory and agent when Finish runs; a crash followed by a fresh clone recovers it without another agent call or authority reconstructed from edited issue text.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and seven acceptance tests covering the complete saved-draft reference change in one pull request. Check 1 passed: every acceptance test fails on the base as required, and the change requires a person to merge.
